resources.string: A phone app in the Metro style — fast, flat, and glanceable. A couple of quick steps and you\'re ready to call.
Dialer 8 works as your default phone app: it dials your calls, shows who\'s calling, and keeps your call history. You can switch back anytime in your phone\'s settings.
To show names and history, Dialer 8 needs access to your contacts, call log, and notifications.
Everything stays on your phone. Nothing is collected, uploaded, or shared — see the privacy policy in the about page.
Full-screen call alerts are turned off for this app, so incoming calls would only show a small notification. Turn the setting on so calls ring properly.
You\'re ready to go. Everything can be adjusted later in settings.
